race.title: Welsh Cottage Christmas Cakes Handicap Chase
race.verdict: SEASETT shaped encouragingly on first start for new connections when runner-up at Hexham in late-August (had breathing operation) and given another try over the larger obstacles, Mickey Bowen's 8-y-o could well be the answer. He gets the nod over Pooroldmackley , who was in good form prior to his most recent effort so can get back on track. Unleash The Beast rounds off the shortlist on return/chasing debut. SEASETT POOROLDMACKLEY (IRE) UNLEASH THE BEAST (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Unleash The Beast (3/1), Seasett (7/2), Owl Of Athens (6/1), Pooroldmackley (7/1), Everyonesacritic (8/1), Bahtiyar (8/1), Leech (10/1), Just Aidan (12/1), Devilsrollthedice (20/1), Disco Davis (33/1)
